title: PROP-080 hook-persistence fix: idempotent pre-push hook install on every decider cycle (clone-reuse-safe)
problem_statement: Integrity run 2026-06-07T01:18Z fired ISS-2621 (critical): decider close-records lacking verification_pattern despite PROP-080's structural pre-push hook (deployed ed511b16, 2026-06-06T05:43:41Z). Forensic audit of origin/main closed-issues.json found 954 total entries matching the lint's violation filter: 937 with fixed_at predating the deploy (historical sunk-cost, hook could not have protected them) and 17 with fixed_at after it (ISS-2599, 2602-2606, 2609-2617, 2619, 2620) — the real bug. ISS-2563 (cited by integrity) falls in the pre-deploy bucket; ISS-2600 is status=wontfix which the canonical lint filter correctly ignores.

dominant_failure_mode.hypothesis: H1 (operator hypothesis, forensically CONFIRMED with a sharper mechanism)
dominant_failure_mode.mechanism: PROP-080's diff (ed511b16) touched ONLY monitor/prompts/reference/decider-patches-and-selfapply.md and monitor/scripts/push-via-api.js. The hook-install lines (L132-137) sit immediately after an UNCONDITIONAL `git clone ... ${CLONE}` (L119) inside the self-apply clone-setup block. Decider's clone (${SESSION}/dome-review-clean) persists across runs in the decider session sandbox; on every post-deploy run the `git clone` step errors on the existing path ('destination path already exists'), the agent skips the clone-setup block including the hook install, and pushes from a hook-less clone. Additionally, decider.md's prelude (the code path that explicitly HANDLES the existing-clone case, L75-105: refresh remote URL + pull --rebase) was never given a hook-install step by PROP-080. Net effect: the hook never existed in the pushing clone on ANY post-deploy run.
evidence: ed511b16 file list: only decider-patches-and-selfapply.md + push-via-api.js + tinker artifacts; decider.md untouched (git show --stat).
decider-patches-and-selfapply.md L119 `git clone` is unconditional in both the ed511b16 tree and current main (grep verified identical line numbers).
decider.md prelude reuse branch (if [ -d ${CLEAN_CLONE}/.git ]) refreshes remote URL and pulls but contains no hook install (L75-105).
Violations recurred on EVERY closure-bearing post-deploy decider run: d4fa543 09:16Z (ISS-2599, 2602-2606), a4e464f 17:14Z (ISS-2609-2617, 2619, 2620) — persistent absence, not intermittent failure.

Lint replay (H2 test): the exact 11 entries added by a4e464f trigger 11 violations under the current lint, which is md5-identical (43d33c4953f5a86a28c416445aa99916) to the copy in a4e464f's tree. The gate logic is correct; it simply never ran.

push-via-api.js (H3 test): PROP-080's lint guard IS present (L60-78) and fires when closed-issues.json is in --files; no evidence of API-fallback use on 2026-06-06 (no 403s — workspace-sync plain-git pushes succeeded minutes before a4e464f; decider run summary records no push failure; no stranded-patches sentinel).
No --no-verify (H4 test) anywhere in prompts/scripts outside prohibition text (grep).
Single-commit pushes per run (H6 test): each violating batch landed in one decider commit; no concurrent decider pushes in the window.

ruled_out.H2: Filter bug — ruled out by replay: 11/11 violations fire on a4e464f's added entries.
ruled_out.H3: API-path bypass — ruled out: push-via-api.js is lint-patched and was not used (no 403 conditions that day).
ruled_out.H5: chmod/exec failure — moot: the install block never executed at all on reuse cycles (decider sandbox not directly inspectable from tinker session, but H5 requires the block to have run, which the unconditional-clone-error mechanism precludes). The fix's [ -x ] check covers H5 defensively anyway.
ruled_out.H6: Concurrent pushes — ruled out: single-commit batches, no racing decider instances in the window.

proposed_fix: Two-layer idempotent install, matching operator's pre-approved H1 fix: (1) decider.md prelude — after the existing-clone if/else, when ${CLEAN_CLONE}/.git exists, (re)install the hook unless it is executable AND references lint-close-records (covers reuse cycles AND H5-style exec loss AND stale hook content). (2) decider-patches-and-selfapply.md — make the self-apply clone step reuse-safe (`if [ ! -d ${CLONE}/.git ]; then git clone ...; fi`) so the existing cat-overwrite hook install (naturally idempotent) executes on every pass, clone-create or reuse alike. Both paths write byte-identical hook content.
files_touched: monitor/decisions/closed-issues.json (954 audit_grandfathered annotations: 937 pre-deploy + 17 post-deploy; +ISS-2621 close record)

validation_simulation.sim_1_reuse_cycle_installs_hook: Scratch git repo with no pre-push hook; ran the new decider.md prelude block verbatim → hook written, chmod +x, output "PROP-083 pre-push hook (re)installed". Second pass → "present and current" (no rewrite). See report-2026-06-07T06-10.json validation section.
validation_simulation.sim_2_gate_blocks_violations: Lint replay on a4e464f's 11 violating entries exits 1 (PROP-076 FAIL banner) — with the hook now guaranteed present on every cycle, that push would have been refused.
validation_simulation.sim_3_current_tree_passes: node monitor/scripts/lint-close-records.js on post-annotation tree: pass (1 newly-added entry = ISS-2621 close record, 0 violations).

relationship_to_prop_080: Does NOT supersede PROP-080 — the filter + gate spec remains canonical. PROP-083 hardens hook persistence only (analogous to PROP-077 Part A defense-in-depth vs PROP-078 structural fix).
